DRIVER’S GUIDE

YOUR WAY.

Explore the city, coast and hills in one connected map. Take any turn, leave the road, and discover six destinations.

W / ↑ AccelerateS / ↓ Brake; hold to reverseA / D Steer front wheels; W to driveSPACE HandbrakeSHIFT NitroH HornM Full map / waypointR / C Recover / cameraL / V Lights / soundG Garage / change carJ Delivery jobs / checkpoint racesO Graphics / traffic settings

Complete jobs and races to earn credits for garage upgrades. Stop inside delivery rings to collect and deliver; pass race checkpoints in order. Recovering adds ten seconds to an active run. Fast travel is unavailable during activities. Progress saves in this browser. Horns get a reaction from nearby drivers and pedestrians. Light traffic follows lanes and signals. Cars and buildings are solid. Grass and sand slow the car. Water returns you to the last safe road. Click the map to set a waypoint, or use its district buttons to travel. This is an original, compact browser driving world.
